workspace_commit_status: No Git repository exists at PROJECT_ROOT; commit hash unavailable and not fabricated.

candidate_definition.primary_evaluation: discovery and future7_window_coverage_status == OBSERVED_FULL_WINDOW and finite seven-dimensional target
candidate_definition.secondary_30d_evaluation: discovery and future30_window_coverage_status == OBSERVED_FULL_WINDOW and finite three-dimensional target

target_definition.primary: signed seven-dimensional 7-day change vector relative to the pre-cutoff 7-day score window, with log1p count changes, active-day change, two direction-share changes, and two event-family-share changes
target_definition.secondary_30d: three-dimensional event-count, unique-counterparty, and active-day change vector

feature_sets.M1: M0 plus frozen temporal gaps, burst/activity dynamics, novelty, repeat, turnover, growth
feature_sets.M2_CORE: M1 plus entropy, reciprocal rates, fan-in/fan-out, exact frozen rapid-forwarding proxy, identifier-free degree ratios

primary.selection: July multivariate standardized MSE; larger alpha if loss tie within 0.001

metrics.primary: paired August multivariate standardized MSE improvement
metrics.ci: percentile 95% cluster bootstrap over August wallets, 2000 replicates
metrics.multiplicity: Holm adjustment for three nested contrasts when treated as formal claims

go_modify_no_go.temporal: >=2% relative improvement, paired CI lower bound >0, >=4/7 dimensions positive/nonnegative
go_modify_no_go.structural: >=2% relative improvement M2_CORE over M1, paired CI lower bound >0, >=3/7 dimensions positive
go_modify_no_go.otherwise: NO_GO_OPENWORLD_STRUCTURAL_SIGNAL or MODIFY_BEFORE_EXTERNAL_VALIDATION; no external labels
